name: Dribble Handoff
idea: Dribble toward a teammate and hand them the ball as they run right behind you.
why: Your body works like a screen. The defender chasing your teammate bumps into you, and your teammate gets a head start.
tryit: Practice handoffs like a relay race: hold the ball out with two hands, and let your teammate grab it as they run by.

frames.say: {1} has the ball. {2} is on the wing, guarded by {X2}.
*Handoff:* {2} runs right behind {1} and takes the ball, like a relay baton. {X2} bumps into {1}.
{2} has a clear path and dribbles straight to the hoop!
Layup! Hand it off, then your body works like a screen.
